title: The Last Habit Tracker You Need, Worth It!
body: I only like this app because it comes with a 1 time purchase and syncs with iPhone and MacBook. It’s very minimalistic design is great. But all of a sudden, it just became too laggy. This was after my 7 day trial. Can’t use on my iPhone 7 anymore.
author: BartmanBookClub

title: Minimal and elegant
body:
I have tried so many other habit tracker apps, including paid ones, and this is the one I stuck with. 

Everything is simple but well executed. The siri voice command and the widget are very nice features.

A suggestion would be to add a menu bar for macos, or just improve the widgets so you can do more with them.

author: k1chie

title: The Most Minimalist Habit Tracker.
body:
After installing apps like: WabiTime, Focus, Structured, Move On, Awakee, Habitify, Sorted, Mindlist, Habitica, and Habit Tracker. I finally settled with Awesome Habits. Why?
This is the most minimalist habit tracker I have ever tried. It has simple yet great design, intuitive interface, covers the most essential features, works across devices, affordable price, lifetime usage, analytic reporting and it simply works. Don’t complicate your habit system or look for messy bells and whistles, try Awesome Habits first before you try something else. It will set the bar afterwards. Keeping a habit is very hard work, this app will surely support you to make it easier.
author: BartmanBookClub
